own: Whatever methods we end up settling on that can be set to differentiate bands, they must be implemented in order to have separate bands. You're not going to have the same bands unless you have modifying features. You have to have things that make the band different, especially if you're going to set the band for the same amount. You could have the band from 200 to 1,000 and you could say it's, or maybe they'd have to be different amounts. But either way, they have to have things that separate them. I'm just not sure we've settled on what all those things could be yet.
